financials_interim.notes: Colombo Fort Investments PLC (CFI, Company No PQ 100) is NOT a conventional trading/operating company -- it is itself an unlisted-fund-style closed-end investment/holding vehicle that holds a portfolio of quoted equity investments (part at Fair Value through OCI, part at Fair Value through P&L) and discloses Net Asset Value per share (Rs.541.25 as at 30.06.2026). Structurally it closely resembles CINV/CIT (same family of Sri Lankan cross-holding investment companies -- CFI's own 20-largest-shareholder note on this filing shows 'Colombo Investment Trust PLC' (CIT) holding 35.32% of CFI, and conversely CIT's own filing this quarter shows CFI holding 28.82% of CIT -- a reciprocal cross-holding; S. Shanmugalingam and Anushman Rajaratnam sign as directors on both companies' filings). Unlike CINV/CIT, however, CFI's own SOFP is a genuine conventional-style balance sheet (Receivables, Prepayments, Cash, Trade & Other Payables all separately disclosed, no current/non-current ambiguity), so it fits this project's standard schema directly rather than needing the fund-specific NAV-only treatment. This is a SINGLE set of statements, single entity (no subsidiaries), so basis=GROUP by convention. Fiscal year end is 31 March, so the quarter ended 30 June 2026 is Q1 of FY2026/27. revenue = the filing's own 'Revenue' line (29,560, Q1 FY26/27 vs 51,170 Q1 FY25/26, -42% YoY) -- not itemised into dividend vs interest income in this filing. cost_of_sales = 'Cost of Investments disposed' (nil this quarter vs Rs.20,431k in the prior-year quarter, when the company realised disposals). The filing's real profit driver sits in a line with NO dedicated schema field -- 'Net change in Fair Value through Profit or Loss Financial Assets' (Rs.45,421k this quarter vs Rs.233,484k prior-year quarter, -81% YoY) -- this is folded into operating_profit ('Operating Profit' 71,777, the filing's own subtotal after Revenue - Cost of disposals + FV change - Administrative Expenses (3,204)) rather than any gross_profit/cost_of_sales derivation, since the schema has no 'fair value gain' field. finance_costs = 2,113 (Finance Costs this quarter; nil prior-year quarter). profit_before_tax (69,664) - tax_expense (0, no income tax charged either quarter) = profit_after_tax (69,664), ties exactly. trade_receivables = 'Receivables' (75) -- an immaterial catch-all receivables balance, not trade receivables in the conventional sense (this company has no trading operations), but it is the closest available schema field and the amount is trivial. inventory left blank -- not applicable, the FVTPL/FVOCI investment portfolio (Rs.4,908,587k total per the fair-value hierarchy note) is not inventory. No borrowings of any kind are disclosed (short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings left blank; the only liability is Trade & Other Payables plus a small Dividends Payable). total_assets (4,909,565) = total_liabilities (70,966) + total_equity (4,838,599) exactly. shares_in_issue = 8,939,651 (per the Stated Capital note) -- cross-checked against EPS: 69,664k / 8,939,651 = Rs.7.793, ties to disclosed EPS Rs.7.79. Cash flow: cash_from_operations = 'Net Cash Flows from (used in) Operating Activities' (-268). capex left blank -- there is no PPE; the only investing outflow is 'Acquisition of Financial Assets at FVOCI' (918), which is portfolio investment activity, not capital expenditure, so it is recorded only in cash_from_investing (-918) and not double-counted as capex. cash_from_financing = 0 this quarter (dividend paid was nil this quarter vs Rs.12,817k in the prior-year quarter). KEY DRIVER: the 73% YoY fall in Operating Profit (Rs.71,777k vs Rs.261,447k) was driven almost entirely by a much smaller unrealised fair-value gain on the FVTPL portfolio this quarter (Rs.45,421k vs Rs.233,484k a year earlier, -81%) plus the absence of any gain on disposals (nil vs a Rs.20,431k realised cost-of-disposal charge booked in the prior-year quarter) -- the underlying 'Revenue' (dividend/interest) line was also down 42% (Rs.29,560k vs Rs.51,170k).
